entities.name: Saint Nicolas' Church, Trnava

entities.summary: Saint Nicolas Church or Basilica of Saint Nicholas is a Gothic/Baroque church in Trnava, Slovakia. In 2009 Pope Benedict XVI granted the parish church of St. Nicolas the honourable title of minor basilica.
